capabilities: Declare card sides in code blocks or frontmatter under heading sections
Pair card sides across notes with generated IDs
Review content by vault, deck, folder, file, or tag
Group cards into nested parent and child decks
Resolve review-statistic conflicts when syncing across devices
extras: Warns that changing a card's ID after rating loses its statistics, and advises rating on only one device at a time to avoid sync conflicts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule and review note content for long-term retention.
summary: Spaced repetition plugin that turns heading sections of notes into card sides and reviews them with the FSRS algorithm.
